Program Coordinator, Criminal Law & Justice Center (4263C), Berkeley Law #89659 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
At Berkeley Law, we are committed to excellence in education and scholarship, as well as equality of opportunity. We believe we have a responsibility to use our substantial intellectual capital to help solve real-world problems and to create a more just society through clinics, research, and policy engagement. We believe that a Berkeley Law degree is a tool for change, both locally and globally, and that we should be educating the leaders of tomorrow. We maintain an environment that nurtures academic and personal growth, respects a diversity of ideas, and stimulates independent thought and critical reasoning.
  
  
The Berkeley Criminal Law & Justice Center is a hub for research, education and advocacy. Blending a data-driven approach with zealous advocacy, the center offers empirical insights into the intricacies of the legal system and policy outcomes.

Under the direction and supervision of the Center's Executive Director and Managing Director, this position assists in a wide range of administrative services, including event planning, communications and social media, business services, and student services, and possibly including IT, facilities, financial support and fundraising outreach. The Program Coordinator is also responsible for long and short-range strategic event planning and supporting all administrative activities.

Tasks vary in scope and complexity, but require high-level independence, self-direction, and decision-making.

Serves as the administrative point of contact and responds to all administrative inquiries; ensures that records and databases are current and accurate; liaises with IT/Media/Facilities/Business Services on program and event needs; and provides other administrative support for the Center.

May serve as a resource to students for forms and other information related to courses, certificate programs, etc.

Serves as the Center's point of contact with Berkeley Law's communications office, coordinating to promote Center news, research, and events through law school channels.

jobs.description:
1.0 FTE Full time Day - 08 Hour R2661096 Hybrid 108610039 Activations and Operational Integrations Business & Administration MENLO PARK, 145 El Camino Real, California

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

  
Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**

Ready to make a meaningful impact?

Located in the heart of Silicon Valley, Stanford Health Care’s mission is to heal humanity through science and compassion, one patient at a time. We are seeking detail-oriented, proactive, and tech-savvy individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment to join our team. If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work at Stanford Health Care.

Drive operational excellence behind the scenes to bring spaces to life.  
Stanford Health Care is seeking a Sr. Program Project Coordinator to join the Activations & Operational Integration (AOI) team. This role provides critical coordination and project support to ensure hospitals, clinics, and administrative and patient care spaces are fully prepared to operate effectively from day one.

The AOI team delivers integrated project management across clinical and administrative space activations, hospital tours, and facilities governance. Standard work, proactive risk management, and cross-functional coordination drive consistent outcomes and ensure alignment between workflows, facility capabilities, and stakeholder expectations.

The Sr. Program Project Coordinator is responsible for coordinating project support activities, including workplan management, meeting coordination and facilitation, and documentation. This role is central to maintaining efficient project execution and supporting both project-level and departmental operations, ensuring seamless delivery across AOI initiatives.

The ideal candidate brings:

* 2–5 years of experience in project coordination or administrative support, preferably in healthcare
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
* Advanced communication skills and the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office with the ability to quickly learn new systems and tools
* Professionalism, attention to detail, and adaptability in dynamic environments

For the complete job description, keep reading.

The Facilities Services division enhances health through leadership, collaboration, and innovation. Our team offers essential non-clinical support 24/7, ensuring safe operations and planning for future needs. We represent the intersection of planning, construction, general services, and facilities operations. Learn more about Facilities Services at: Facilities Services | Stanford Health Care

The Ambulatory Facilities & Activations business unit leads the transition from design to go-live, managing activations, space changes, and facility readiness across Stanford Medicine. By integrating project management, collaboration tools, and operational planning, AOI delivers efficient, well-coordinated spaces that support excellence in care and experience.

Activations and Operational Integration (AOI) specialize in providing integrated project management for clinical and administrative space activations, hospital tours, and facilities of governance. Through standardized procedures and proactive risk management, the team ensures aligned workflows and strong stakeholder engagement.

If you are interested in joining Stanford Health Care, please read the job description below and apply online.

**A Brief Overview**  
Sr Program Project Coordinators manage daily project activities in conjunction with project and senior project managers who provide centralized oversight/structure to multiple VP areas in executing complex, organization-wide projects (such as the 500P activation). Projects require the complex coordination of space planning, facilities construction, logistics, compliance and clinic operational planning. In addition, Senior Project Coordinators independently manage related projects of smaller scope. Senior Project Coordinators assume responsibility for key project team members, deliverables and activities, resource/equipment/information coordination. Senior Project Coordinators use their independent judgement to resolve or triage critical issues, identify risks and escalations, provide project schedule updates and exercise financial responsibility.  
  
**Locations**  
Stanford Health Care  
  
**What you will do**

* Independently manages smaller scale projects.
* Solely responsible for project outcomes and successful execution of activations related to opening.
* Provides direction to project team members, determines and plans day-to-day project activities and apportions project work among team members. Ensures project team members have the tools, processes and standard work necessary to complete activities.
* Working from project plans, identifies task owners and schedules and provides day-to-day coordination of project related tasks. Identifies potential problems/impediments and resolves as appropriate. Keeps the project focused on its objectives. Identifies missed deadlines, assesses impact and appropriate mitigation efforts. Identifies interdependencies and adjusts timetables/tools as necessary. Works with affected parties to ensure satisfactory project completion.
* Plan and develop the initial project schedule, making certain that all scheduling conflicts are resolved. Use independent judgement in triaging critical issues, escalations and action items.
* Updates Project status, schedules, IMP, timeline, issues/risks, escalations, next steps, accomplishment, budget etc. in project management tool.
* Coordinate and independently lead and manage project committees, workgroups, taskforce and other project meetings.

jobs.description:
Research Program Management - San Francisco

**About the Team**

Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models, ensuring our models are deployed responsibly and have a positive impact on society. Our work spans diverse research and engineering initiatives—from system-level safeguards and model training to evaluation and red-teaming—all aimed at mitigating misuse and maintaining our high bar for safety. We lead OpenAI's commitment to developing and deploying safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), fostering a culture of trust, responsibility, and transparency.

Our goal is to continuously learn from deployments, distribute AI’s benefits widely, and ensure that powerful tools remain aligned with human values and safety considerations.

**About the Role**

The Safety Measurement Research Program Manager drives OpenAI’s strategy for safety measurement and evaluations, partnering closely with safety research, data science, and engineering to advance how we measure harm and safeguard efficacy across research and production.

You will work directly with researchers, data scientists, policy owners, and product teams who contribute to or use our measurement systems, identifying the most important problems to solve and shaping the data, dashboards, tools, and workflows we build for them. This role combines measurement expertise, product judgment, and cross-functional execution: you will engage with evaluation results and data workflows, make prioritization tradeoffs, and drive work from problem definition through rollout and iteration.

This position is based in San Francisco, CA, with relocation assistance available.

**In this role, you will:**

* Define strategic priorities and product roadmaps to improve safety measurement and evaluation approaches and scale our measurement platform to new use cases, products, and the needs of cross-functional teams
* Partner closely with research, data science, engineering, policy teams, and other stakeholders to craft a vision for understanding safety outcomes and prevalence across our products, and translate that vision into concrete programs of work.
* Drive the integration of cutting-edge AI safety research into OpenAI’s safety measurement and evaluation platforms, working with researchers, data scientists, and engineers to navigate technical tradeoffs, coordinate dependencies, and resolve blockers.
* Develop and continuously refine clear, actionable success criteria that effectively capture our ambitions with safety measurement and evals.
* Represent quantitative progress on safety to senior leadership.

* Have a strong foundation in data science, statistics, economics, or a related field, and hands-on experience with measurement or evaluations.
* Enjoy working at the intersection of data science and AI safety research, translating evolving measurement needs into clear requirements, priorities, and roadmaps.
* Can independently drive complex, cross-functional programs from problem definition through rollout, building alignment and unblocking decisions in ambiguous spaces.
* Ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions, and exercise sound judgment about technical tradeoffs and the strengths and limitations of metrics and evaluations.
* Build strong partnerships across research, data science, engineering, policy, and product, and communicate complex findings clearly to technical teams and leadership.

jobs.title: Protocol Project Manager (Sr. CRC) - Gastrointestinal Oncology Program
jobs.description:
The Protocol Project Manager (PPM) will work within the GI Oncology program and serve as the main point of contact between the study team including faculty and clinical research coordinators (CRC), outside entities such as sponsors, and various departments within UCSF providing support. The candidate will be accountable for clinical trial study start up, maintenance, and close out.

A successful applicant will thrive in a fast-paced environment, take initiative, and resolve problems and provide clarity in ambiguous situations. We are looking for a go-getter with excellent relationship building skills, and a team player who can also work independently.

Duties Include:
  

* Complete pre-activation tasks such as feasibility surveys and assessment with study team; lead pre-site selection teleconference calls
* Coordinate protocol reviews and submissions to Disease Site Committee and Protocol Review and Monitoring Committee
* Serve as Disease Site Committee Administrator, set agendas, and lead meetings in close collaboration with the Site Committee Chair
* Identify ancillary committee approval with study team required by a protocol and initiate the process for review; complete various applications to ancillary committees such as radiation safety and biosafety applications.
* Assist PI with the development of concept sheets, protocols, investigational brochure or package insert, and consent forms working in close collaboration with the Protocol Development team for investigator-initiated trials. Ensure timely processing of new protocols through the activation pipeline including Medicare coverage analysis and budget sign off, informed consent approval and IRB submission, contract execution, and billing set up; prepare reports and trackers to keep the Disease Site Committee appraised of activation status for all new protocols
* Review, provide feedback, and approve Medicare coverage analysis and budgets for complex clinical trials; serve as point person from study team for budget negotiations
* Prepare and make submissions to IRB; prepare and maintain regulatory binders
* Collaborate with ancillary departments to set up operational aspects of new studies (e.g. pharmacy, radiology, and labs)
* Ensure policies mandated by the UCSF IRB, HDFCCC, federal government, any outside entity, and study team are followed during trial activation pipeline, maintenance phase and close-out.
* Coordinate and prepare for sponsor or collaborator visits such as site initiation, audit, and monitor visits.
* Update clinical trial management databases.
* Assist study team to develop contingency action plans.
* Lead trainings within the Disease Site Committee and HDFCCC
* Develop and write group specific SOPs and policies
* Ensure that all investigators maintain the proper credentials and maintain these records in central regulatory binder (e.g. medical licenses, CVs, GCP/HSP certifications, NCI CTEP registration, SIP accounts, etc.); serve as registration coordinator to help investigators maintain these varied accounts
* Flexibility to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Excellent organizational skills, multitasking and communication both written and spoken.

**Department Overview:**

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is one of only two cancer centers in the Bay Area to receive the prestigious designation of “comprehensive” from the National Cancer Institute (NCI).
  
The HDFCCC integrates the work of researchers and clinicians dedicated to four fundamental pursuits: laboratory research into the causes of cancer progression; clinical research to translate new knowledge into viable treatments; compassionate, state-of-the-art patient care; and population research that can lead to improvements in prevention, early detection, and quality-of-life for those living with cancer. The twin pillars of precision medicine and precision population health guide research and treatment at HDFCCC.

  

Required Qualifications

* BS/BA Degree in a related area; or equivalent experience
* Project management or coordinator experience
* Experience with clinical trials regulatory affairs, or related clinical trials experience such clinical research coordinator experience

**Custom Scope**

Under the general direction of the Associate Director, Campus Design and Construction, the incumbent is accountable for project management services to ensure design and construction projects are on schedule, within budget, high-quality, cost-effective, and appropriate to client program needs. Projects focus on renovation work within world-class research facilities and the administrative spaces that support them. The incumbent has a first-line responsibility for communicating effectively with project stakeholders, ranging from departmental administrators to highly technical researchers and facilities support staff. Excellent customer service skills are essential at all phases of the project.

The incumbent organizes, plans, and controls the design and construction efforts on projects ranging from $5,000 - $70,000,000. Services include all elements of project management from concept through project closeout, including initial scoping, budgeting, funding, procurement, impact mitigation, construction management, and closeout of large and small projects.

This involves selecting professional design staff (architects and engineers), general contractors and subcontractors, coordinating the activities of clients, construction inspectors, and others associated with the projects; managing project progress to achieve overall project objectives consistent with department standards and in alignment with customer expectations including, budget, cost and quality; resolving problems that arise in the projects; working with state agency officials to ensure compliance and safety.

Emphasis is placed on the incumbent's ability to complete the following in a complex research environment: analyze available information to provide conceptual-level estimates at early stages of project development, review constructability and suggest alternative solutions, and proactively manage the design phase to ensure efficient and cost-effective project delivery.

Project managers may be responsible for coordinating the activities of Real Estate Assistant Project Managers as directed.

**Department Overview**

The organization of UCSF Real Estate is focused on the development, planning, delivery, and management of physical space for UCSF. Key responsibilities include a unified approach to oversee the active UCSF growth planned on a multi-site campus and to manage the complex metropolitan environments affecting capital assets and projects, and efforts to align municipal challenges with maximum effectiveness in support of the UCSF mission.

UCSF Real Estate is an integrated unit that enables the alignment of development, planning, design, construction, and management of facilities and a lease portfolio of 1M square feet across UCSF. **Position Title**: Finance and Operations Manager

**Location**: San Francisco, CA (hybrid; 3 days per week in-person in our SF office)

**About SMART**

SMART (Schools, Mentoring and Resource Team, Inc.) champions education equity by supporting students in overcoming systemic barriers on their journey to a college degree. We envision a community with equitable pathways to college graduation for every student in San Francisco. SMART provides a unique twelve-year continuum of support that starts in 4th grade and extends through college, including school support, after-school enrichment, summer programming, college prep, and college persistence support. As a result, SMART Scholars are more than four times more likely to graduate college when compared to their peers. Furthermore, while only 21% of low-income students who enter college will graduate within six years, SMART Scholars are currently persisting at a rate of more than 80%.

SMART’s Values:

* Community: We build a community that celebrates diversity, thrives on teamwork, and appreciates everyone’s contributions. Through community, we are stronger.
* Equity: We are committed to systems and processes that are just, fair, and inclusive, enabling all people the opportunity to belong, participate, and reach their full potential.
* Empowerment: We believe the path to empowerment and self-advocacy is through the encouragement, support, and guidance of those around us.
* Learning: We believe education and life-long learning enhance our understanding of our world, our place within it, and provide the tools to change it. Through embracing challenges and learning opportunities, we make progress.
* Joy: We center joy in our community and practice. We view joy as an act of liberation, which unleashes creativity, strengthens relationships, and propels the work that we do.

**Position Description**

jobs.title: Strategy and Operations Manager, AI-Native Business Operations
jobs.description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

**Strategy and Operations Manager, AI-Native Business Operations**
==================================================================

San Jose, California, United States

**Job category:** Business Operations **Job ID:** 137017-en\_US

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role helps the leaders of NetApp's product organization decide where people and money go, and makes those decisions faster and better informed. It spans planning, forecasting and tracking the organization's people and resources, and the budget across headcount, open reqs, software, cloud and AI spend. On each of these the analyst brings a point of view, not just the numbers behind it.

The role combines three skillsets that usually live in three different people: the consultant who frames an ambiguous question and lands a recommendation with senior leaders; the analyst who builds the model and can defend every number in it; and the AI-first builder who turns recurring work into systems that run themselves. The unit of delivery is a better decision, made sooner, on numbers leaders trust.

The role sits within the AI-Native Business Operations team in the product organization, and reports to the Director, AI-Native Business Operations. The team works in close partnership with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition and engineering leadership across the product organization.

A few principles shape how the team approaches its work:

* **We start from outcomes, not from tasks.** The first question on any piece of work is what it is for and what good looks like, not how to automate the current steps.
* **One source of truth.** People, plans and spend live in one trusted, connected source, and every report and dashboard draws from it.
* **AI first, with human judgment throughout.** AI shortens the time to an outcome; our judgment tests every assumption and validates each step, from the source data to the final recommendation.
* **Accountability does not stop at the answer.** The analyst stands behind the method and the data as well as the result.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Plan, forecast and track.** Build the plans and forecasts for the product organization's people and resources, and track them month by month: where engineering capacity and spend go across products and investment themes, and how hiring, attrition and backfills move against plan.
* **Manage the budget.** Hold the product organization's spend against target with Finance, from headcount and open reqs to software, cloud and AI, and find where to consolidate, renegotiate or stop.
* **Advise product leadership.** Turn the numbers into a clear point of view for vice presidents and their staff, and run the planning cycles and leadership reviews where those decisions get made.
* **Operationalize strategic initiatives.** Take a leadership priority from idea to working program: define its scope, set milestones and checkpoints, build the plan and put it in motion, then measure the results and keep leadership updated as it lands.
* **Automate the recurring work.** Build agents, automations and dashboards with Claude and the team's other AI tools that make each cycle take less effort than the last.
* **Keep the source of truth trustworthy.** Maintain the connected data behind every leadership view, with the checks and audit trail that let a leader defend any figure in front of Finance or the executive staff.
* **Work across functions.** Partner with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, IT and data owners on access, definitions and changes, within NetApp standards for privacy and acceptable use.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience, including a minimum of 3 years in consulting. This experience may have been gained in:

* The strategy, operations or analytics practice of a management consulting firm, such as McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte, or a comparable practice
* A business operations, strategy and operations, or FP&A team at an AI-first technology company
* A founding or early operating role at a startup building AI-native products

* Uses AI as the default way of working, across analysis, writing and building, with examples to show, and builds validation into each step so the speed never costs accuracy. Familiarity with Claude Code or Cursor is preferred.
* Learns new domains, systems and data quickly, and acts without waiting for a perfect brief; comfortable where the problem is still being defined.
* Expert scenario and financial modeling: headcount, cost and what-if models that leaders use to make decisions, and the judgment to spot when a number is wrong.
* A technical, hands-on approach to data: reads data architectures and table schemas, writes the joins in SQL or Python, and treats data preparation as part of the job, from cleaning and de-duplicating records to validating formats and keys before any number is used. Experience with workforce or finance data in systems such as Workday or Snowflake is a plus.
* A track record of influencing directors and vice presidents without authority, with recommendations that were acted on.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to disagree productively and adjust as evidence evolve

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**PROJECT MANAGER - Redwood City, CA**

**\*\*\* We do not sponsor employment/work visas at this time, if you need sponsorship now or in the future, unfortunately, your application will not be considered \*\*\***

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Project Manager (PM I) leads the planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of business and technology initiatives that support organizational objectives. This role manages projects from initiation through implementation and closure, including a brief post-production stabilization period. Upon successful stabilization, ownership and ongoing support are transitioned to the designated business and technology support teams.

The Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for project delivery and partners closely with business stakeholders, executive sponsors, IT teams, vendors, operational partners, and leadership to coordinate activities, manage risks, track and resolve issues, ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, and drive successful outcomes that align with business goals.

While the primary focus of this role is project leadership and delivery, the Project Manager is also expected to perform Business Analyst functions when project needs require. This includes facilitating requirements gathering, documenting business and functional requirements, analyzing business processes, supporting solution design discussions, validating business needs, and assisting with testing and implementation activities. The Project Manager serves as a bridge between business and technical teams to help ensure solutions meet business objectives and operational needs.

In addition to managing assigned projects, the Project Manager plays an active role in project portfolio demand and intake management. This includes reviewing incoming project requests, ensuring requests are properly documented and filed within the project intake system, validating completeness of submitted information, coordinating follow-up activities as needed, and maintaining visibility into the project demand pipeline.

**Why Provident?**

Provident Credit Union was established in 1950, and we rank among the top 10% of credit unions in the US. We believe having a culture that is accepting, supportive, diverse, and inclusive makes us all better. Provident has been a Bay Area “Top Workplace” since 2017, and our employees rank us on Glassdoor as one of the best credit unions in the nation.

Our values are:

* Listen
* Get Better
* Do What’s Right

**Essential Functions:**

  
**Project Implementation & Delivery**  
Lead approved and prioritized cross-functional business and technology projects from initiation through closure.
  
Ensure Vendor Management due diligence requirements have been completed by the project owner prior to project implementation.  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies in partnership with project sponsors and stakeholders.  
  
Develop and maintain risk registers, including risk identification, assessment, mitigation strategies, and contingency plans, to minimize organizational exposure and project risk.  
  
Develop project work plans, schedules, key milestones, and target dates; drive project execution and adjust plans as necessary to ensure successful delivery of committed outcomes.  
  
Effectively apply PMO methodologies and enforce project governance, implementation, and delivery standards.  
  
Ensure project documentation is accurate, complete, current, and maintained within approved repositories.  
  
Business Analysis & Solution Validation  
  
Facilitate requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, vendors, and technical teams.  
  
Document and maintain business requirements, functional requirements, business rules, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.  
  
Analyze current-state and future-state business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and process optimization.  
  
Validate proposed solutions with stakeholders and confirm business needs, requirements, and project objectives have been addressed.  
  
Testing, Implementation & Operational Readiness  
  
Coordinate testing activities, user acceptance testing, implementation planning, deployment readiness, and go-live activities.  
  
Partner with impacted business units to ensure operational procedures, departmental workflows, job aids, training materials, and supporting documentation are developed or updated to reflect new or modified processes, systems, controls, regulatory requirements, and operational changes introduced by the project.  
  
Ensure all tracked issues, defects, risks, and action items are resolved, mitigated, formally accepted, or appropriately documented prior to deployment.  
  
Confirm stakeholder expectations have been met and obtain final approval and signoff from impacted business owners and the appropriate Vice President(s) prior to production deployment.  
  
Facilitate a successful transition to operational ownership and support following implementation and stabilization.  
  
Portfolio Intake & Demand Management  
  
Support administration and management of the project portfolio demand and intake pipeline.  
  
Ensure project requests are appropriately documented, categorized, tracked, and routed through the intake process.  
  
Maintain accurate intake and portfolio records to support project prioritization, capacity planning, and portfolio reporting.  
  
Provide visibility into project demand, resource needs, and portfolio pipeline status to leadership.  
  
**Knowledge & Business Acumen**

Financial & Operational Management
  

* Understand project budgeting, financial planning, and cost management principles.
* Understand cost-benefit analysis and business case development.
* Understand vendor contracts, project-related legal documents, and procurement processes.

jobs.title: Real Estate Project Manager
jobs.description:
Skeleton Technologies is looking for a Real Estate Project Manager to join our team in California, US.

About Skeleton

Skeleton Technologies is a global leader in critical power infrastructure for AI data centers and electrical grid stability, founded in 2009. Power today is more than electricity.

It is national security, digital continuity, and economic resilience. Skeleton is the Backbone of Power: equipping AI data centers, electrical grids, defense systems, and critical infrastructure with the resilience to withstand surges, instability, and failure. Our power systems protect GPU clusters from millisecond-level spikes, enable hyperscalers to run at higher rack densities without grid compromise, and make AI data centers up to more 40% energy efficient. We keep the lights on when grids fluctuate, stabilising electrical infrastructure under the combined pressure of accelerating renewable energy deployment and surging AI demand.

When power fails, critical operations stop. We exist to prevent that in microseconds. Powering the infrastructure that powers everything else.

Responsibilities

* Own the full path from “no site” to “production-ready building” for our new cell production line in California.
* Find and secure the right location, lead the design and construction of all utilities and infrastructure, and obtain every permit needed to build and operate.
* Act as the owner’s representative toward brokers, landlords, utilities, authorities, designers and contractors, with single-point accountability for delivering the site on time, on budget and fit for the production process.
* Define the utility concept for the cell line together with process engineering and equipment suppliers.
* Lead the design of the electrical supply, including utility interconnection (such as PG&E or SCE), substation, distribution, backup power and UPS.
* Lead the design of HVAC systems, including dry rooms or clean rooms with tight humidity and temperature control.
* Lead the design of chilled water, cooling towers, compressed air, vacuum, nitrogen and other process gases.
* Lead the design of process and purified water, wastewater pre-treatment, solvent recovery and exhaust treatment.
* Lead the design of fire protection, gas detection, hazardous materials storage, IT/OT and building management systems.
* Select and manage architects, engineers of record and specialist consultants through all design phases.
* Set the delivery strategy (such as design-build, EPCM or GMP) and lead contractor tendering and award.
* Manage contractors through site works, shell, fit-out and utility installation, including tie-ins to production equipment.
* Enforce Cal/OSHA safety, quality and schedule requirements, and run change control and claims management.
* Lead commissioning and handover, including as-built documentation and operator training.
* Build and run the permitting roadmap from day one, as permitting is often the critical path in California.
* Obtain all entitlements and permits where applicable, including zoning, land use and CEQA environmental review, building, grading, MEP and fire permits under the California Building Code and Title 24, air permits from the local air district (such as BAAQMD or SCAQMD), CUPA hazardous materials filings, wastewater discharge and stormwater permits, and the certificate of occupancy and operating permits.
* Build constructive relationships with planning departments, fire marshals, air districts, water boards and utilities.
* Own the capex budget, schedule and risk register, and report status and decisions to management.
* Coordinate with production, engineering, EHS, procurement, finance, legal and HR.
* Manage consultant and contractor contracts and keep documentation audit-ready.

  
**Requirements**  

* 10+ years in industrial facility development or construction project management, with at least one manufacturing plant delivered end to end, from design through commissioning.
* Proven delivery of heavy industrial utilities such as high-capacity power, HVAC, process water, gases, dry rooms or clean rooms.
* Hands-on California permitting experience with CEQA, planning departments, air districts, CUPA and fire authorities.
* Experience managing capex budgets above $50M with multiple contractors and consultants.
* Project management skills across budget, schedule, risk and change control, plus contract management and tendering (design-build, EPCM, GMP).
* Technical understanding of MEP systems, process utilities and building codes (CBC, Title 24, fire code).
* Negotiation skills with contractors, utilities and authorities, and strong reporting and presentation skills in fluent English.
* Proficiency with MS Project, Primavera, Procore or similar tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in civil, mechanical or electrical engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field.
* Nice to have: a background in battery, semiconductor, chemical, pharmaceutical or other high-tech manufacturing, a Master’s degree or MBA, and certifications such as PMP, PE, LEED AP or CCM.
* You are self-driven and comfortable as the first person on the ground, structured and decisive under time pressure, build trust quickly with authorities, partners and internal teams, and communicate clearly across cultures and levels.

  
**Benefits**  

* The opportunity to help build and scale an international deep-tech energy-storage company with a strong startup mindset
* The chance to support an ambitious mission alongside globally recognized customers such as Volvo, Škoda, General Electric and Hitachi Energy
* An extra day of holiday for your birthday!

jobs.title: Architectural Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About GUA**

Geddes Ulinskas Architects is an architecture firm with offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles, specializing in high-end custom homes, substantial residential renovations, and additions. Our work combines thoughtful design, carefully developed details, and close collaboration with clients, consultants, and builders.

We are seeking an experienced Architectural Project Manager for our San Francisco office. This hands-on position combines project management, architectural design development, Revit drawing production, and BIM modeling.

**Job Overview**

Working closely with the Principal, you will manage multiple projects, monitor schedules and deliverables, coordinate staff and consultants, and track architectural fee and labor budgets. You will also personally develop architectural solutions, prepare drawings, and review construction documents.

The ideal candidate has direct experience in high-end custom residential architecture, strong technical skills, and the confidence to lead discussions with clients, consultants, contractors, and permitting authorities. You must provide clear direction, address issues promptly, and follow through consistently on decisions and commitments.

* Communicate required decisions and their effects on scope, budget, and schedule.
* Support construction administration, including RFIs, submittals, architectural site observations, and drawing revisions.

**- Team Leadership and Meeting Documentation**

* Give clear direction to designers and junior staff regarding priorities, deliverables, quality, and deadlines.
* Lead productive meetings and keep discussions focused on decisions and next steps.
* Prepare and distribute timely meeting minutes documenting decisions, action items, responsible parties, and due dates.
* Maintain action-item logs and follow through until outstanding items are resolved.
* Maintain organized project records and written confirmation of significant instructions and changes.
* Address coordination issues professionally and promptly.

* At least 7 years of architectural experience, including at least 3 years of direct project management experience.
* Direct experience delivering high-end custom residential projects, including new homes and substantial renovations.
* Strong architectural design judgment and knowledge of residential materials, construction methods, and detailing.
* Experience managing project schedules, architectural fee and labor budgets, staff assignments, and consultant deliverables.

jobs.title: Portfolio Leader (Cross Portfolio + Strategy & Operations)
jobs.description:
### **The Position**

At Roche/Genentech, we have a bold Pharma Ambition to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2030. With this vision top of mind, our purpose is to co-create and deliver the target portfolio for the benefit of patients. We want you to join our vision and be part of our passionate, collaborative, global PSM community!

  
  

We are a strong, close, trusting community that lives new ways of working and operates from a creative mindset. We are THE place for talent to grow and contribute; our talent feels valued, connected, and a sense of belonging to something impactful. We have high impact; customers draw on our expertise to help them deliver the target portfolio more effectively/efficiently. We stop lower-value work. We’re BOLD. We try things, openly discuss and learn from mistakes and failure, experiment and iterate to achieve our aspirations.

  
  

**The Opportunity**
===================

As Portfolio Leader, you will serve as a strategic partner and operational leader at the heart of our mission to actively shape and deliver a transformative Pharma portfolio. You will partner with the Head of PSM to drive the strategy, business planning, operations, and team culture, ensuring our PSM team is aligned, agile, and positioned for impact in a complex and evolving landscape.

  
  

Your responsibilities will also include leading and contributing to cross-portfolio initiatives, partnering with senior Pharma leaders and cross-functional teams to shape portfolio strategy, assess portfolio dynamics, and develop insights and strategic options to inform portfolio-wide decisions and prioritization. The balance between PSM-focused strategy and operations and broader portfolio-focused work may shift over time based on business needs.

Accountabilities include, but are not limited to, the following areas:

* **Strategic Partner:** Partner with the Head of PSM and the PSM Leadership Team to realize the strategic vision for PSM, and translating vision into actionable priorities. Partner with fellow LT members to co-create and implement PSM-wide initiatives.
* **PSM Ecosystem Architecture and Functioning:** Serve as the primary architect and steward of the PSM ecosystem, ensuring that culture, communications, and operational frameworks are seamlessly integrated to drive collective success. Lead the planning and facilitation of PSM LT and All Staff meetings, leveraging agile practices to enable rigorous discussion, clear decision-making, and actionable outcomes. Oversee the holistic health of the PSM ecosystem by monitoring the intersection of team performance and organizational health, proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen the ecosystem.
* **PSM Talent Deployment Architect and Decision Support:** Build and manage systems and processes to match team skills and interests to the highest impact business needs, in support of PSM priorities.
* **Operations Leadership and Culture Building:** Operationalize strategic priorities while championing a connected team culture of learning, adaptability, operational excellence, and fun within the team.
* **Liaison & Network Integrator:** Represent PSM on Product Development workstreams as needed. Take the lead on maintaining a strong Portfolio network with peer groups in gRED, pRED, and GPS.
* **Cross-Portfolio Strategy and Special Projects:** Partner with senior Pharma leaders and teams to shape portfolio-wide strategy and lead cross-portfolio initiatives and special projects. Structure complex, ambiguous questions, define the work and analysis needed, synthesize evidence and stakeholder perspectives into clear recommendations, and align contributors on plans and milestones to deliver agreed outcomes.
* **Portfolio Assessments and Insights:** Assess and communicate portfolio dynamics, including risk, value, mix, competitive positioning and performance, to inform portfolio strategy and prioritization. Synthesize quantitative and qualitative analyses, external benchmarking and business planning inputs into clear, executive-ready insights and recommendations.
* **Portfolio Decision Quality and Prioritization**: Partner with decision-makers to frame portfolio-level choices, assess strategic options and investment trade-offs, and draw on valuation inputs, business cases and risk assessments where relevant. Help shape fit-for-purpose decision pathways and prioritization approaches that support timely, high-quality portfolio decisions.
  

  

**Who You Are**
===============

  
  

You bring the following background and experience:

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree in science, business, or related field preferred.
* Minimum 10 years’ experience in operations, stategy and/or R&D within the biopharma industry.
* Experience in strategy development and linking strategy to tactics.
* Structured problem-solving and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous questions, synthesize information and develop clear, practical recommendations.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to set priorities, manage milestones and dependencies, and deliver special projects.
* Strong understanding of the drug development lifecycle
* Experience in cross-portfolio strategy or portfolio management, including assessing portfolio dynamics, strategic options and prioritization trade-offs.
* Strong analytical acumen, with the ability to interpret portfolio-level risk/value assessments, business cases, metrics and benchmarks and turn them into actionable recommendations.
* Demonstrated experience as a strategic thought partner to senior leaders and teams, with a track record of driving change and innovation.
* Extensive strategic planning, stakeholder management, and operational execution expertise, including leading multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  

  

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Devices Beta (ADB) Team is your hall pass to play at work!! We are responsible for the “real world validation” for Kindle eReaders, Fire Tablets, FireTV products, and Emerging products…think, Amazon Smart Oven and Amazon Basics Microwave. How do we do this? By playing with these products every day! We work with product and engineering teams to prepare new product launches, system software and app updates, and marketplace expansions. Our goal is to gather feedback and expose issues and bugs prior to the product launching, so we delight our customers with products beyond their expectations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The ADB Team needs an experienced Program Manager to help us build and execute programs to validate the customer experience during the product development cycle. You will work with end users and a wide variety of internal teams to develop the strategy and execute the program to confirm from a customer perspective we are ready to launch. You will be a “hands on” contributor to support and troubleshoot issues, resolve problems, and keep the feedback flowing. Along the way, you’ll identify opportunities for improvements and put processes and tools in place to help us scale. You will track, communicate status, and independently drive issues to resolution. Cross-team coordination, program management, and an ability to learn and understand new technologies are essential.  
  
A day in the life  
Our programs are global and composed of Amazon employees across the company. We put pre-released devices and/or software in the hands of beta testers who represent our target customer profile ("people all about smart home automation", "people who love to read", or "people who are native speakers of French"). Working with our product team counterparts, we ask testers for “no holds barred” feedback to tell us what works and what needs to be fixed. Our bar is always being raised and we strive to achieve an Amazon 4-Star or better product every time!  
  
About the team  
The Amazon Devices Beta Team is responsible pre-launch customer feedback for our products. The team is composed of program managers who love technology and devices. Together with product owners, we plan and execute beta programs focused on gathering early customer feedback to help Amazon ship devices and software that delight customers. Our objective is to leverage the voice of the customer to validate and improve the experience and make an informed decision regarding launch readiness.

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience

### **Description**

Alta Planning + Design seeks an **Associate** **Landscape Architect (I-II)** for our **Oakland** location. This position is a great opportunity for someone who shares these values and who is interested in an interdisciplinary project environment working on a range of project types, from parks to streetscapes to greenways.

Alta is a mission driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people-centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Kikoff is a profitable, pre-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money.
  
We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially.

When part of the product is causing friction, you’ll bring the data, work with Product and Engineering to fix the root cause, and help define how we measure CX, including contact rate, CSAT, and customer risk signals.

* Analyze CX performance across channels (chatbot, support, product journeys)

* Partner with Customer Operations, Product, and Data teams to implement solutions
Own initiatives end-to-end: problem definition solution design launch* measurement
* Translate customer insights and data into actionable improvements

**Expertise & experience required**
-----------------------------------

* Hands-on experience with CX tools (Zendesk, chat platforms, CSAT tools)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and drive execution
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, or Operations teams
* High ownership and bias toward action

**Nice to have:**

* Exposure to automation, workflows, or AI-driven tools
* Experience building dashboards or working with data tools (SQL, Looker, etc.)

$132,000 - $155,000 USD

**SALARY RANGE**

$82,000 to $87,000 Annually

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

The Facilities Project Coordinator supports the day-to-day operations of the Building Operations department through coordination of facilities requests, work orders, vendor activities, preventive maintenance workflows, and operational administration. The position serves as a central point of coordination and follow-through, helping ensure facilities activities are organized, tracked, communicated, and completed in a timely and consistent manner.

Working under the supervision of the Senior Project Manager, the Facilities Project Coordinator operates with initiative and appropriate autonomy to manage routine workflows, resolve issues within established procedures, and escalate matters requiring technical, budgetary, compliance, or leadership decisions.

This position supports strategic facility initiatives of the organization anticipated to occur over a two-year period. It is anticipated that employment in this position will continue through approximately fall 2028. The Facilities Project Coordinator role is an at-will position; length of employment will be determined based on project completion dates and schedules.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Work Order & Issue Management**

* Support the coordination of facilities requests alongside Facilities Operations team, ensuring each issue is logged, prioritized, assigned, communicated, and closed with documented follow-through.
* Administer the Angus work order system, including ticket review, assignment coordination, status tracking, reporting, user support, and workflow maintenance.
* Monitor open, overdue, recurring, and unresolved service requests; follow up proactively and escalate safety concerns, delays, or items requiring technical, budgetary, compliance, or leadership decisions.
* Assist the Facilities Operations Manager with scheduling vendors for planned maintenance, urgent service needs, and unplanned repairs.
* Coordinate work orders, vendor activity, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions through completion, confirming that required documentation and closeout information are recorded.
* Communicate service impacts, access needs, project updates, and work status to staff, vendors, and other stakeholders.

**Facility Inspections & Follow-Through**

* Coordinate quarterly facility walkthroughs with preschool site directors, document identified needs, submit work orders, and track completion.
* Coordinate quarterly inspections across all sites with Facilities and Program Support teams, document findings, open and assign work orders, and follow through on corrective actions.

**Tracking, Documentation & Administration**

* Maintain facilities project and request trackers by logging new requests, updating priorities and status, and monitoring work from initiation through completion.
* Maintain organized shared drives so project documentation, communications, vendor records, and closeout materials are current and easy to retrieve.
* Manage routine facilities administration, including vendor records, invoice routing, purchasing support, reporting, and recordkeeping.

**Project & Operational Support**

* Assist with facilities and IT project coordination tasks, including scheduling, documentation, access coordination, status tracking, and follow-up for project managers.
* Coordinate contractor access and support operational readiness activities related to scheduled facilities work.
* Provide coverage for the Facilities Operations Manager during absences to maintain continuity of routine facilities workflows and issue escalation.
* Support facilities, compliance, process-improvement, and special projects as assigned, including documentation and workflow updates.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Two or more years of experience in facilities coordination, workplace operations, office administration, property management, hospitality, or a similar operational support role.
* Experience coordinating maintenance requests, vendors, contractors, or service providers in a complex or high-volume environment.
* Experience using ticketing, work order, or maintenance management systems; Angus experience preferred.
* Highly meticulous with strong file management and record-keeping habits that hold up under a high volume of concurrent work.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take initiative, prioritize competing demands, and follow work through completion with limited supervision.
* Ability to process information and communicate clearly and concisely.
* Strong organizational, administrative, communication, and customer Service skills.
* Experience supporting purchasing, invoicing, vendor administration, or operational recordkeeping.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Teams, SharePoint, and Lists.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**  
This position is primarily performed on-site at JCCSF facilities and includes work in office, program, storage, mechanical, and other operational spaces. Occasional remote work may be considered when appropriate for specific tasks and operational requirements.

The position requires regular movement throughout the facility and frequent interaction with staff, vendors, contractors, and members of the Building Operations team. The employee may occasionally encounter noise, dust, active maintenance work, mechanical equipment, and areas with varying temperatures.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**  
Duties include regular walking throughout the facility, standing, sitting, using stairs, accessing storage and operational areas, and performing physical tasks consistent with a facilities coordination position.

The employee must be able to lift and carry items weighing up to twenty pounds. Reasonable accommodation may be provided as appropriate.

**STATUS:** Benefited, non-exempt

**HOURS:** 40 hours per week

**SCHEDULE:** Monday - Friday, general business

jobs.title: Postmarket Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**About this opportunity:**

  

Freenome is approaching FDA approval and commercial launch of SimpleScreen™, our cfDNA-based colorectal cancer detection test. As we cross that milestone, we need a dedicated owner for the postmarket quality infrastructure that commercial launch demands — someone who can build and run a complaint handling program that works across two distinct regulatory environments.

  

This role also owns the CAPA program — ensuring that complaints and quality events drive real corrective action, not just documentation. You will serve as the escalation point and technical mentor for junior team members managing non-conformances and laboratory incidents, and you will be the Quality interface with our commercial partners to ensure customer and partner feedback is captured, evaluated, and acted on. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence and a mentorship mandate. The role reports directly to the Senior Director, Quality Assurance and is an onsite role based in our Brisbane, California headquarters.

  

**What you'll do:**

* Own the end-to-end complaint handling process — from intake and triage through technical investigation, root cause analysis, disposition, and closure — applying the distinct regulatory requirements applicable to CAP/CLIA laboratory quality events and IVD postmarket complaints under 21 CFR 820/QMSR and ISO 13485.
* Own the CAPA program: ensure that complaints, non-conformances, and laboratory quality events drive rigorous corrective action with documented root cause analysis, implementation, and effectiveness verification. Maintain CAPA records in the eQMS with traceability required for CAP/CLIA compliance.
* Serve as the escalation point and technical mentor for junior team members managing non-conformances and laboratory incidents — coaching investigation rigor, reviewing findings, and ensuring quality events at all levels feed appropriately into the CAPA program.
* Serve as the primary Quality liaison to commercial partners and customer-facing teams as it relates to complaints and CAPA: establish and maintain processes for capturing, routing, and evaluating partner- and customer-reported feedback and complaints, and communicate investigation status and corrective actions back to relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor and analyze complaint, CAPA, and non-conformance trends across all quality event streams; identify systemic issues and escalate with supporting analysis and recommended corrective actions to Quality leadership.
* Compile and present quality signals data: complaint volumes, CAPA quantities and their status, investigation outcomes, and trend analysis for management review and postmarket surveillance reporting.
* Participate in change control reviews and risk evaluations as the postmarket quality representative; provide historical complaint and CAPA data to inform risk assessments for product and process changes.
* Escalate issues to Quality leadership and serve as the Quality delegate in CAP, CLIA, NYSDOH, and FDA audit or inspection settings as appropriate.

**Must haves:**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, clinical laboratory science, or a closely related field.
* 7+ years of quality assurance experience with direct ownership of a complaint handling or postmarket surveillance program in a regulated environment — IVD, medical device, clinical laboratory, or a combination.
* Working knowledge of CAP/CLIA laboratory complaint and quality event requirements and how they differ from FDA postmarket complaint obligations under 21 CFR 820/QMSR.
* Hands-on CAPA program experience: root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, effectiveness verification, and program-level trending.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor or develop junior quality staff — someone who builds capability in others rather than absorbing work themselves.
* Experience interfacing with external customers or commercial partners on complaint intake, communication, and resolution.
* Strong technical writing skills; ability to produce clear investigation reports, CAPA records, and trend analyses suitable for regulatory review.
* Proficiency with an electronic QMS (eQMS) platform for complaint records, CAPA tracking, and document control.

**Nice to haves:**

* Hands-on experience with CAP LAP inspections (COM, GEN, MOL checklists) and NYSDOH Part 58 laboratory permit requirements.
* Experience in a molecular diagnostics, cfDNA, or NGS-based testing environment.
* Familiarity with MDR evaluation under 21 CFR Part 803 in the context of an LDT/IVD organization.
* Prior experience building or formalizing complaint intake processes between a clinical laboratory and commercial partners or health system clients.
* ASQ CQA or equivalent quality certification.

**Benefits and additional information:**

The US target range of our base salary for new hires is $134,425 - $170,100. You will also be eligible to receive equity, cash bonuses, and a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits depending on the position offered. Please note that individual total compensation for this position will be determined at the Company's sole discretion and may vary based on several factors, including but not limited to, location, skill level, years and depth of relevant experience, and education. We invite you to check out our career page @ *freenome.com/job-openings/* for additional company information.

Freenome is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, and we value diversity. Freenome does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
Make a real difference in patients’ lives—join **Elevate Patient Financial Solutions** as a **Hospital Based Patient Advocate** and help guide individuals through their healthcare financial journey. This full-time position is located 100**% onsite at a hospital in San Francisco, CA,**with a **Monday-Friday schedule from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM**. Driving required must have a valid drivers license.  
  
Bring your passion for helping others and grow with a company that values your impact. In 2024, our Advocates helped over 823,000 patients secure the Medicaid coverage they needed. Elevate’s mission is to make a difference. Are you ready to be the difference?  
  
As a **Hospital Based Patient Advocate**, you play a vital role in guiding uninsured hospital patients through the complex landscape of medical and disability assistance. This **onsite, hospital-based role** places you at the heart of patient financial advocacy—meeting individuals face-to-face, right in their hospital rooms, to guide them through the process of identifying eligibility and applying for financial assistance. Your presence and empathy make a real difference during some of life’s most vulnerable moments.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
The purpose of this position is to connect uninsured hospital patients to programs that will cover their medical expenses. As a Patient Advocate, you will play a critical role in assisting uninsured hospital patients by evaluating their eligibility for various federal, state, and county medical or disability assistance programs through bed-side visits and in-person interactions. Your primary objective will be to guide patients face-to-face through the application process, ensuring thorough completion and follow-up. This role is crucial in ensuring that uninsured patients are promptly identified and assisted, with the goal of meeting our benchmark that 98% of patients are screened at bedside.  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Screen uninsured hospital patients at bedside in an effort to determine if patient is a viable candidate for federal, state, and/or county medical or disability assistance.
* Complete the appropriate applications and following through until approved.

* Other duties as assigned.

* Prior hospital experience preferred

* Proficient experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite with emphasis on Excel and Outlook

Hybrid employees working from home are expected to comply with Elevate’s Remote Work Policy, including but not limited to working in a private and dedicated workspace where confidential information can be shared in accordance with HIPAA and PHI requirements.

**Benefits**

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**Office Manager**

* **Location:** San Francisco, CA — Onsite, 5 days/week
* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time, Non-Exempt
* **Compensation:** $28–35/hour, depending on experience
* **Reports To:** Dr. Benjamin Kruman
* **Desired Start Date:** ASAP

**About The Orofacial Pain Specialty Group**

The (the OPS Group, for short) is a new specialty practice in San Francisco dedicated to providing thoughtful, comprehensive care to patients experiencing complex orofacial pain conditions—TMJ disorders, chronic headaches and migraines, sleep apnea, and related conditions that too often go misdiagnosed or dismissed elsewhere.

The practice is led by , DDS DABOP, a board-certified orofacial pain specialist and Assistant Clinical Professor at UCSF School of Dentistry.

We're built around a simple idea: patients dealing with complex orofacial pain deserve private, unhurried, evidence-based care—especially the ones who haven't found relief anywhere else. That means real time for diagnosis, conservative treatment planning, and a practice that never feels rushed. The Office Manager sets that tone before a patient even sits down in the chair.

We're at the very beginning: a new office, a new team, and a lot still to build.

**About the Role**

The Office Manager is the person who makes the practice run — the first voice a patient hears on the phone, the first face they see when they walk in, and the person keeping everything else on track behind the scenes.

Our practice is built on four values—compassion, communication, innovation, and education—and the Office Manager brings them to life before a patient ever sits down in the chair. Compassion means genuine warmth for people who are often anxious or in pain. Communication means being clear and responsive with both patients and the team. Innovation means helping us build better systems as a brand-new practice figures out how it wants to run. And education means constantly learning—new tools, new processes, better ways to take care of people.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll move fluidly between greeting patients, managing the schedule, ordering supplies, coordinating vendors, and building the systems and processes the practice doesn't have yet because it's brand new. You'll work directly with Dr. Kruman and have real input into how the practice runs day to day—not just executing someone else's playbook, but helping write it.

**We're looking for someone who takes ownership without waiting to be asked.** You'll rarely be told exactly how to do something—you'll be trusted to figure it out, ask good questions when you need to, and follow through. If you notice something's off, you fix it or flag it. That instinct matters more to us than having every process memorized on day one.

**What You'll Do:**

**Patient Experience & Front Desk**

* Welcome patients and create a warm, professional, comfortable experience from the moment they arrive.
* Manage check-in/check-out and keep the front desk organized.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments, follow-ups, and referrals in AthenaHealth.
* Answer phones and respond to patient inquiries clearly and professionally across phone, email, and other channels.
* Maintain a calm, welcoming environment for patients who may be dealing with pain, anxiety, or uncertainty—and protect their privacy and confidentiality at all times.

**Office Operations & Practice Support**

* Own the day-to-day administrative operations of the practice—supplies, vendors, building management, maintenance, deliveries, and general facilities needs.
* Maintain organized files, records, and documentation; support basic financial processes like invoices, payments, and expense tracking.
* Serve as a trusted operational partner to Dr. Kruman—anticipate needs, coordinate his calendar, and solve problems before they become bigger ones.
* Help implement new tools, systems, and processes as the practice grows, and look for ways to improve how things run.
* Assist with onboarding new vendors, partners, and (eventually) team members.
* Build relationships with patients, referring providers, vendors, and the local community—and represent the practice well while doing it.
* Help plan and host occasional events for the practice, its partners, and its patients.

**Who You Are**

You're **warm, capable, organized, and proactive** — the kind of person who notices what needs to happen next and takes it on without being asked twice.

**Requirements**

* 2–3+ years of experience in a role with real people-facing responsibility and operational ownership—healthcare, dental, hospitality, or another high-touch professional services environment
* Front-desk, office administration, or practice coordination experience—or something close enough that the transition is short
* Exceptional organizational skills; you don't let details slip
* Clear, warm communication, in writing and in person
* Real discretion handling sensitive, confidential information
* Ability to hold multiple priorities at once without losing your calm
* Follow-through—you do what you say you're going to do, every time
* Comfortable learning new systems and technology—we'll provide guidance, tutorial videos, and coordinate with AthenaHealth's training resources to get you up to speed on our EHR/scheduling software
* Available in-office 5 days/week, with occasional evening events
* CPR certification required within 2 weeks of your start date—not needed to apply. OPS Group covers the full cost of certification and training.

jobs.title: HSE Program Manager
jobs.description:
Whether you're a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

**WHY ROSENDIN?**
-----------------

**Committed. Innovative. Engaged.**
-----------------------------------

If you're looking to take your career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. Since our founding over 100+ years ago, Rosendin has been driven to positively impact the communities where we live and work. We are an organization built on integrity and we have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. As one of the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED electrical contractors in the United States, you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success. When our people succeed and fuel our success, we reward them. We'd love to have you as a shareholder!

**YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY**
-------------------------

The HSE Programs Manager is a pivotal individual contributor responsible for the administration, coordination, and continuous improvement of Rosendin's enterprise-wide Health, Safety, and Environmental programs. This role ensures the effectiveness and compliance of critical corporate HSE systems, contractor prequalification, training, and policy administration, directly contributing to the safety and well-being of our employee-owners and projects nationwide. You will serve as a key liaison, collaborating across departments and with external partners to maintain Rosendin's unwavering commitment to safety excellence in electrical construction.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Administer and continuously improve Rosendin's enterprise-wide HSE programs, systems, and platforms.
* Manage corporate contractor prequalification platforms, coordinating responses, maintaining compliance data, and tracking performance metrics.
* Serve as the primary system administrator for the HSE program software, managing configuration, user access, workflows, incident management, and developing analytical reports and dashboards.
* Oversee the telemedicine program, including user access, provider coordination, utilization tracking, developing training materials, and supporting field personnel.
* Lead the recommended development, revision, implementation, and communication of corporate HSE policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring regulatory compliance and alignment with industry best practices.
* Support the full lifecycle of corporate safety training initiatives, from content development and administration to tracking completion and assessing program effectiveness.
* Maintain and update the corporate HSE intranet site, ensuring timely publication of policies, forms, safety alerts, and best practice documentation.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Risk Management, Learning & Development, Human Resources, Legal, and external partners to ensure seamless integration and effectiveness of HSE programs.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL**
-------------------------------------

* Advanced knowledge and practical experience with HSE management systems and contractor prequalification platforms (e.g., ISNetworld, Avetta, Origami Risk).
* Demonstrated ability to recommend development, revision, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive HSE programs, policies, standards, and procedures for a large-scale construction environment.
* Strong analytical skills to interpret HSE data, track performance metrics, identify trends, and develop actionable reports and dashboards.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex HSE concepts to diverse audiences, from field personnel to executive leadership.
* Proficiency in project management and organizational skills to manage multiple initiatives and deadlines with significant autonomy.
* A proactive approach to identifying and addressing compliance gaps, staying current with regulatory changes (OSHA 29 CFR 1926) and industry best practices.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across various departments and with external vendors to achieve program objectives.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO US**
------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* A minimum of 7-10 years and CSP/ASP **or** Bachelor's Degree and 4-6 years and CSP/ASP of progressive experience in Health, Safety, and Environmental roles, with at least 3-5 years focused on program management, administration, and system oversight.
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Associate Safety Professional (ASP) certification highly preferred.
* OSHA 30-hour Construction certification required; advanced OSHA knowledge (e.g., 500/501) desirable.
* Proven experience in a construction or industrial environment, managing complex HSE programs for a large organization.

**TRAVEL**
----------

* Up to 25%

**WORKING CONDITIONS**
----------------------

* Work is primarily performed in an office environment, but may involve occasional visits to active construction sites, requiring awareness of varied site conditions.
* Requires the ability to sit or stand for extended periods, use a computer, and communicate effectively via phone and in-person.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 20 pounds occasionally, and to walk, stoop, kneel, and climb as needed during site visits.
* May be required to wear company-provided Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when visiting construction job sites.
* Flexible work schedule may be required to support various time zones across Rosendin's nation

Berkeley MDes is a studio-based program in which students are immersed in community, collaboration, and hands-on learning.
