-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. jobs.title: Account Manager -SMB, Growth & Retention (HR Services)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid- US-based Account Management team. As an account manager at Rippling, you are the CEO of your book of business. You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account managers in our SMB segment own revenue retention and growth of one of our fastest growing customer segments. This is a quota-carrying sales role.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the HR Services channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, introduction calls, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based approach
* Navigate a strategic sales process by building relationships with multiple external and internal stakeholders through remote and in-person meetings
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution as part of managing the broader customer relationship
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments, directly influence Rippling’s product roadmap, and increase operational efficiency
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role by being a proactive and strategic partner to customers, tailoring your approach to maximize Rippling product adoption based on each customer’s unique business operations

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a consultative discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings\* for employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

* Commission is not guaranteed

130,000 - 130,000 USD per year(US)  
125,000 - 125,000 USD per year(US)

jobs.title: Case Manager II - SF Outpatient Services
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** M-F 9-5
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
The Outpatient Program is specifically designed for people who struggle with substance use disorders, mental health issues or co-occurring disorders. The Outpatient Program works with high-risk populations from a variety of backgrounds. Our programs are open and welcoming to adult participants, of any gender identity. We accept the majority of participants who seek Outpatient treatment, including walk-in’s, referrals from other agencies and step-down transitional clients from residential treatment programs.
  
  
The Case Manager II is responsible for assessing treatment needs; monitoring and evaluating problem lists and progress and facilitating interdisciplinary approaches. The Case Manager II coordinates an approach to the delivery of health, substance use, mental health, and social services, linking clients with appropriate services to address specific needs and achieve stated goals. The Case Manager II’s duties include care coordination, maintaining positive working relationships with outside community partners, scheduling appointments, arranging transportation, assisting with acquiring medications, ongoing care and discharge planning, and crisis intervention.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* Carries a caseload and meets service delivery goals.
* Work as an active team member and closely collaborate with team members.
* Help clients get and stay engaged in SUD treatment.
* Help clients transition between levels of care.
* Assess for opioid overdose and ensure beneficiary has Naloxone if appropriate.
* Interface with a multidisciplinary team in treatment planning and service delivery.
* Develop and assess the effectiveness of individualized treatment and consumer progress.
* Maintain documentation in compliance with agency, HIPAA, and DPH standards.
* Assist in the ongoing maintenance of consumers’ charts and other related documentation.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Program Manager.
* Arrange work schedule in accordance with the agency’s needs.
* Comply with the agency’s policies and procedures.
* Attend internal and external meetings as assigned.
* Create a safe space for clients and maintain appropriate boundaries.
* Meet expected performance standards as assigned by supervisor.
* Provide “whatever it takes” services to consumers including providing services where the consumer lives, assisting with housing, benefits, employment, education, transportation, childcare, medical and other needed services.
* Provide case management services to clients as assigned.
* Serve as a care coordinator for clients as assigned. Responsibilities include coordination of all services with other providers and completion of all coordinated care documentation.
* Provide case management services to clients as assigned.
* Assist client in developing independent living skills to promote independence and self-sufficiency.
* Assist in crisis and symptom management.
* Acts as buddy to new hires.

And perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
Education, Certification, and Experience
  

* High school diploma or GED.
* AOD Registration + 2 years of case management experience.

OR
  

* AOD Certification
* Valid CA Driver’s License.
* First Aid and CPR certification.
* Experience working with the criminal justice population preferred.
* Experience working successfully with issues of substance abuse, mental health, criminal background, and other potential barriers to economic self-sufficiency preferred.

Knowledge and Skills
  

* Some experience providing case management services is required.
* Culturally competent and able to work with a diverse population.
* Knowledge of housing, employment, SSI resources, and success with linking clients.
* Ability to enter data into various electronic systems while maintaining the integrity and accuracy of the data.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work cooperatively and effectively as part of an interdisciplinary team and independently assume responsibility.
* Strong initiative and enthusiasm and willingness to pitch in whenever needed.
* Able to communicate well at all levels of the organization including working with organization leadership and high-level representatives of partner organizations.
* Able to work within a frequently changing project scope while maintaining overall direction and structured priorities.
* Knowledge of co-occurring disorders and trauma-informed treatment.

Veritus was born from a simple belief: the conversations between lenders and their customers deserve better technology. We build AI agents that talk with borrowers by voice, text, email, and chat, from the first loan application through the final payment. Our platform is built for lenders, card issuers, and collection agencies who want to transform their operations with AI. Backed by Y Combinator, Crosslink, and Threshold, our AI agents already handle thousands of conversations every day.

We're looking for an Operations Associate who wants to learn how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it, and are seeking someone who thrives at the intersection of organization, execution, and AI.

**What will the Operations Associate do?**
------------------------------------------

The Operations Associate keeps Veritus running: the San Francisco office, the leadership team's operating cadence, and the cross-functional projects our COO needs done, so that routine work runs on schedule and every important item gets done.

Reporting directly to our COO, Kasia Gora, you will split your time roughly evenly between running our San Francisco office and owning operational projects for the COO. From the Monday leadership meeting to the holiday party, you will manage meeting materials, OKR tracking, vendors and budgets, interview scheduling, new hire setup, team events, and business travel. You'll work with the COO every day and with the whole leadership team, and there is a clear path to Chief of Staff for the right person.

**Who will love this job?**
---------------------------

* You thrive when you can drive high impact across a whole company, and you bring the same care to every task, big or small. You're energized by learning how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it.
* You are relentlessly positive and view yourself as a pillar of company culture, and you get excited by all the possibilities to shape it through your work and interactions.
* You enjoy working in an entrepreneurial, AI-first environment where AI tools are the first thing you reach for.
* You are an execution expert: you keep dozens of open items on track with trackers and checklists, and you finish each one on your own, so the COO only has to ask once.
* You feel at home working with people inside and outside the company: you coordinate schedules across the leadership team, candidates, and interviewers, and you follow up with vendors and procurement teams until you have what you need. You take pride in how you show up, knowing that you are a beacon of Veritus’ values and culture!
* You communicate with precision: your updates, follow-ups, and SOPs are concise, accurate, and polished, so leaders can act on them right away.
* You take pride in building repeatable processes: you like turning a manual workflow into a documented, AI-assisted process that someone else could run.
* You are a scrappy, relentless problem-solver who figures things out and writes the playbook as you go, and who measures success by outcomes: action items closed, materials ready on deadline, and an office that runs smoothly because you run it.
* You want your work to matter and you want to work with folks who both laugh and get things done. You bring rigor as well as a sense of humor!

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Leadership Operations**

* Run the leadership team's operating cadence: schedule leadership meetings and offsites, track OKRs, and follow up on action items until they close.
* Prepare recurring company materials, including weekly All Hands slides and KPI reporting, ready by the deadline every week.
* Take special projects off the COO's plate and run them end to end.

**Office Management and Events Planning**

* Run the San Francisco office: snacks and supplies, packages and shipping, vendors, mail, guests, facilities, and the office budget.
* Schedule and support company offsites, internal team events, and business events, on budget and on time.
* Coordinate business travel for the team.

**Hiring and Onboarding**

* Schedule all candidate interviews promptly as candidates advance.
* Get every new hire's desk, office access, welcome basket, and first-week schedule ready for day one, using a checklist you build and maintain.

**Finance and Processes**

* Assist with invoicing, accounts receivable follow-up, budgets, and expense tracking.
* Turn repetitive workflows into documented, AI-assisted processes that someone else could run.
* Jump on new and unexpected tasks as they come up.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

Our ideal candidate...

* …has experience in an operations, office management, project coordination, or similar organizational role.
* …is smart and quick to learn, with a strong work ethic and a deep sense of ownership.
* …is eloquent in writing and in person: concise, accurate, and polished.

jobs.description:
Rondo is accelerating industry's transition to lower-cost, zero-carbon heat and power.

Our Rondo Heat Batteries turn low-cost renewable electricity into continuous, high-temperature heat and power, enabling industrial facilities to replace fossil-fired boilers without costly process changes. We are looking for a People Operations Specialist to run the day-to-day engine of our global People function. You will own international employee lifecycle operations, global mobility, and our platform for EOR employees and contractors. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves getting the details right. This role will have a huge impact on both Rondo's overall operations & the employee experience!

  

**What You Will Do** *(key responsibilities for this role include but are not limited to):*

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 1 year of experience in technical leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------

At YouTube, our top priority is keeping our community safe, and protecting minors is at the very heart of that mission. As a Product Manager within the YouTube Trust and Safety organization, you will join the Minor Safety team at the forefront of building the next generation of safeguards. You will manage the age assurance models and proactive detection systems that ensure users receive age-appropriate experiences across YouTube's rapidly growing ecosystem.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of technology and policy. You will collaborate closely with engineering, design, legal, and operations teams to launch Machine Learning and AI-powered classification technologies. By breaking down regulatory and safety requirements into product strategies, you will guide safety features from conception to execution, making an impact on millions of minors.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

* Collaborate with Engineering, Policy, Legal, Privacy, and Operations teams on cutting-edge classification technologies and safety approaches.
* Solve complex problems by partnering cross-functionally to translate global regulatory requirements into actionable product requirements.

The salary range for this position is $100,000.00-$150,000.00 annually.

jobs.description:
**Our Mission**
---------------

As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers.

(\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026)

**Day to Day**
--------------

In this role, you’ll conduct business analysis across large, strategic, or complex programs, partnering with cross-functional teams and business partners to evaluate processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive effective business outcomes. You’ll leverage experience in a PMO or other business functions to coordinate priorities, align partners on objectives, scope, and success measures, and ensure initiatives are delivered efficiently with minimal oversight. A key focus will be process mapping and documenting detailed HR workflows, identifying process gaps, dependencies, redundancies, and opportunities to standardize and optimize end-to-end business processes. You’ll also identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to reduce manual effort, improve scalability, and optimize costs without compromising quality.

You’ll translate business needs and complex information into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and data-driven narratives that support decision-making across diverse audiences. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional partners to assess current-state processes, define future-state workflows, document business requirements, and support process improvements that enhance operational efficiency and consistency. Additionally, you’ll manage competing priorities, support queue-based work as needed to meet SLAs, and maintain high-quality deliverables while ensuring business objectives are achieved.

--------------------

* Own the end-to-end analysis workstream across complex programs, sequencing deliverables, managing dependencies, and maintaining a single source of truth for requirements, models, risks, and decisions.
* Set and enforce documentation standards (BRDs/FRDs, user stories with acceptance criteria, process/data flows, decision and risk logs) to ensure traceability from requirements to testing and outcomes.
* Develop data-driven business cases and executive-ready narratives that inform strategy, funding, and prioritization decisions.
* Conduct change enablement at scale, including impact assessments, cutover and communication plans, training inputs, and adoption metrics to ensure successful cross-functional transitions.
* Proactively identify, triage, and mitigate risks and interdependencies; prioritize by impact and drive issues to resolution.

* Define measurement frameworks for launches, including KPIs/OKRs, instrumentation needs, and post-launch reviews; mentor peers and codify best practices to elevate team standards.

* Advanced BA Methods at Scale: Own analysis across complex programs; establish high standards for requirements, flows, and documentation quality.
* Leverage experience within a PMO or other business functions to lead process mapping and documentation of detailed HR workflows, identifying process gaps, dependencies, redundancies, and opportunities to standardize and optimize end-to-end processes.
* Strategic Problem Solving: Root-cause and systems thinking to craft scalable, sustainable solutions; balance cost, quality, and speed.
* Program-level Change & Risk: Anticipate interdependencies, mitigate risks, and communicate change effectively across functions.
* AI/Automation Leadership: Drive responsible adoption across programs; reduce manual effort and increase consistency and scalability.

jobs.description:
**Remote.** Open to candidates in Canada or in the following US states: Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Vermont, and Virginia (excluding the New York City, Boston, Philadelphia, and Washington DC metro areas).

### **Who Are We?**

Thanx is a leading loyalty and guest engagement platform for regional and national restaurants. We help brands drive profitable growth by increasing guest frequency, growing digital sales, and reducing reliance on discounts. Most loyalty platforms work for guests who are already loyal. Thanx unifies loyalty, digital ordering, and marketing automation in one platform that turns first-time and casual guests into regulars, treating loyalty as a business outcome, not a program, and engaging across the entire guest base.

Thanx has raised more than $30M from elite investors including M33 Growth, Ribbit Capital, and Sequoia Capital. Our success is rooted in a culture that has attracted some of the best talent in the country, and we are proud of strong employee tenure, a track record of internal promotions, and the company-wide shift to working AI-native over the last 18 months. We credit our cultural "core behaviors" with these accomplishments: Think Boldly, Execute Reliably, Focus on What Matters, Say "Thanx" Genuinely, Encourage Diverse Perspectives, and Lead, Virtually.

### **Who Are You?**

You like figuring out why something broke. A reward didn't apply, a location stopped sending transactions, an order failed. You keep digging until you have an answer you can back up with data.

You're comfortable with technical tools and you pick up new systems quickly. You may not have worked with restaurant POS systems or payments before, and that's fine. You can explain what you found to a merchant or a teammate who doesn't know the technical details.

You already use AI in your daily work, and you want to be somewhere that expects it.

Everyone at Thanx has equity and is expected to operate like an owner. That means real intensity, including evenings and weekends when the work calls for it. If that isn't what you're looking for right now, this isn't the right role. We would rather you know that before you apply than after you start.

### **Position Overview**

Merchant Operations makes sure our restaurant partners' setup works: their loyalty programs, mobile apps, online ordering, and the POS and other integrations behind them. We work closely with the Implementation team to launch merchants, then with Customer Success to make sure the program keeps operating effectively. Our part is the technical configuration, and after launch we monitor location health, investigate issues, and get root causes fixed.

You'll report to the Director of Merchant Operations and Support and work day to day with Support, Customer Success, Implementation, Product, and Engineering. You'll own a real piece of the work from your first months, not a narrow ticket queue.

### **How We Work With AI**

"With great power comes great responsibility." Uncle Ben

AI has changed what a day on this team looks like. Investigating an issue used to mean pulling data from several systems by hand. Now an agent can gather the evidence, and your time goes to figuring out what it means. We build our own monitors, lookups, and triage tools, and we expect everyone on the team to build, not just use them.

These tools are wrong often enough that you have to check the numbers and question the first explanation before anything reaches a merchant or a colleague. That part is still your job.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Configure merchant setups.** Set up and update loyalty, rewards, app, and online ordering for new and existing merchants. This is a high-volume part of the job, so accuracy and speed both matter.
* **Connect partner integrations.** Link merchants to their POS, ordering, and delivery partners, handle credentials, and work with partner teams when something needs their side.
* **Investigate and resolve issues.** Take escalations from Support and Customer Success, work out what is actually happening, and either fix it or give Engineering a clear bug report with the evidence.
* **Monitor location health.** Catch locations that go quiet, integrations that break, and cards that stop transacting before merchants report them.
* **Manage card network enrollment.** Enroll locations with Visa, Mastercard, and Amex, and troubleshoot when transactions don't flow the way they should.
* **Build and improve automations.** Turn repetitive manual work into monitors, lookups, and workflows the whole team can use.
* **Communicate clearly.** Write updates for merchants and teammates that people can act on without a follow-up question.

### **How We Will Know It's Working**

At six months, you're handling the team's core configuration and investigation work on your own, your diagnoses hold up when Engineering reviews them, and you've shipped at least one automation the team uses.

At twelve months, you own an area end to end, such as an integration, a card network, or a monitoring area, and you've made a visible difference in how the team works.

### **What We're Looking For**

We don't believe in rigid requirements, but success in this role typically involves:

* Experience in a technical support, operations, implementation, or similar role where you diagnosed problems across multiple systems.
* A track record of finding root causes, not just closing tickets.
* Comfort with data. SQL is a big plus, and we'll teach what you need if you have the aptitude.
* Experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to speed up analysis, troubleshooting, or workflows.
* Clear written communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* A habit of automating repetitive work when you see it.
* Comfort in a lean, fast-moving environment where priorities shift.

jobs.title: Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nerdio**

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

**About the role**

Nerdio is hiring a Digital Program Manager to orchestrate the scaled customer experience across Customer Success. You will own the automated journeys end to end, and act as an internal consultant to the rest of the CS organization: finding friction in the customer journey and removing it with automation and agentic AI.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success and work alongside the Pooled CS team, but your reach is wider: the plays you build are designed for reuse across Customer Success, so customers get one seamless experience no matter who owns the moment. This is a builder role with no named book of business. You bring the ownership and customer-first urgency of a CAM or TAM to cross-functional programs, and you are comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity.

**What you'll do**

**Orchestrate the scaled customer experience**

* Own the digital journey from onboarding through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion readiness. Build, launch, monitor, and iterate the plays and automations at each stage.
* Build the triggers and handoffs that bring in a CAM or TAM at the right moment (health thresholds, renewal risk, expansion signals, escalations, champion changes, customer requests), following the coverage model set by the strategy lead.
* Deliver against the current and future-state journey maps owned by the strategy lead. Surface the friction points you find in the data and in the field, and close them so the experience feels the same regardless of who owns the moment.

**Act as an internal consultant to Customer Success**

* Lead discovery with CS teams: ticket analysis, stakeholder interviews, and data review to find where manual, repetitive, or inconsistent work hurts customers or burns CAM/TAM capacity.
* Recommend and build the fix: automation, signal-based triggers, and agentic AI. Give teams plays they can turn on today.

**Lead agentic AI and automation**

* Move the program from static plays to adaptive, agentic journeys for higher-complexity moments, such as personalized onboarding and automated EBR/TVR one-pagers.
* Equip CAMs and TAMs with agentic insights that make their jobs easier and return capacity to them.
* Evaluate tools, run pilots, and set guardrails so AI-driven touches are accurate, on-brand, and hand off to a human when one is needed.

**Run the program and the partnerships**

* Own program and project management from discovery to launch to iteration: scope, plan, sequence, and keep a current view of the roadmap, status, and dependencies.
* Partner with Marketing on every lifecycle communication, RevOps on segmentation and metrics, Product on telemetry and in-app messaging, Support on ticket signals, and Sales on expansion.
* Prove impact. Tie each play to NRR, adoption, and risk reduction, run test-and-learn cycles, and share results broadly.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in digital customer success, lifecycle or adoption marketing, CS operations, or program management for a scaled customer segment.
* A track record of leading cross-functional programs from idea to launch and influencing partners without direct authority.
* A consultative approach: you can run discovery, facilitate working sessions, and turn what you hear into a prioritized plan.
* Hands-on experience with CS, marketing automation, or CRM platforms, and the ability to build or configure automated journeys.
* Practical experience with, or strong curiosity about, AI agents and LLM-based workflows, and sound judgment on where AI should and should not act.
* Data fluency: you use product telemetry, health scores, and attribution to choose what to build and show what worked.
* Strong prioritization, risk management, and written and verbal communication for audiences from CAMs to executives.
* A builder mentality and comfort with ambiguity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, cloud, or the Microsoft and MSP ecosystem.
* Experience with Partner Success or Support operations.
* Hands-on use of no-code or low-code agent builders and prompt design.

**Benefits and Incentives**

* Competitive Base and Incentive Plan
* Stock Options
* Health and Welfare Plans\*
* Life and Disability Plans\*
* Retirement Plan\*
* Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!

WE ARE HIRING!

Deal Operations Manager — Real Estate (Remote, Contract)

* Company: Portfolio.AI

* Location: Remote (United States)

* Job type: Contract (1099)

* Pay: $750 per deal file / $200,000+ Annually

* Schedule: Monday to Friday, flexible hours; reachable by phone during business hours

**About Portfolio.AI**

Portfolio.AI is a real estate investment and acquisition company. We buy residential and commercial properties across multiple states, often using creative financing such as seller financing, subject-to and assignments. We work with a network of lenders, title companies, agents and an outside transaction coordinator to close several deals each month.

**About the role**

We're hiring a Deal Operations Manager to keep every deal moving from signed contract to closing. You'll be the main point of contact for realtors and the link between our team, lenders, title, our transaction coordinator and our Extension Handler.

This is not a paperwork role — our transaction coordinator prepares and files documents. You own the people side: communication, follow-up, deadlines and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**What you'll do**

* Introduce the team at the start of every file so all parties know who does what

* Send a complete point-of-contact list (names, roles, phone, email) at handoff

* Collect the realtor for each file and serve as their main point of contact through closing

* Send a weekly deal update on every active file: status, next steps, deadlines and blockers

* Lead a short weekly pipeline call with leadership

* Work with our Extension Handler to secure extensions before any date lapses

* Escalate any stuck or at-risk file within 24 hours, with a suggested fix

* Chase open decisions and outside parties (lenders, title, agents) until each item is resolved

* Track monthly results: days to close, extensions used and deals that fell out

* Build and improve templates and processes as we grow

**Systems you'll run**

* Deal file sheet: sent at kickoff with the buying entity, key principal, loan type, lender rules and every contact

* Entity document vault: a ready packet for each company entity, sent within 1 hour of any request

* Payment watchlist: every fee per file (earnest money, appraisal, extension fees, invoices) with who pays and when

* Decision log: open decisions with an owner and a due date, followed up until made

* Deal tracker: one shared view of every file's stage and next action

**How you'll work with our transaction coordinator**

* The TC handles contracts, signatures, disclosures, title and escrow paperwork, and closing prep

* You handle people and pipeline: the realtor relationship, team updates, follow-ups, extensions and reporting

* The TC flags deadline risks; you act on them with the Extension Handler

*• Simple rule: paperwork goes to the TC, people go to you!*

**What we're looking for**

Required

* 2+ years in real estate transaction coordination, title or escrow, mortgage processing, or real estate operations

* Clear, fast communication by phone, text and email

* Highly organized; able to track deadlines across many files at once

* Comfortable working directly with realtors, lenders, title companies and investors

* Proficient with Google Workspace, spreadsheets and e-signature tools (DocuSign, PandaDoc) Slack for communications

**Nice to have**

* Experience with investor or creative finance deals (seller financing, subject-to, assignments)

* Familiarity with DSCR and Non-QM lending

* Experience closing deals in multiple states

**How success is measured**

* Every file gets a team intro and contact list at handoff

* Weekly updates go out on time, every week

* No deadline lapses without an extension in place

* At-risk files are escalated within 24 hours

* Days to close and extensions used go down over time

**Compensation**

* $750 per deal file managed = $80,000 - $200,000+

* Remote, flexible schedule

* Room to grow as our deal volume increases

**How to Apply**

Apply with your resume and a short note answering two questions:

1. How many active transactions have you managed at once, and what type?

2. Tell us about a time you kept a deal from missing a deadline.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

Vivid Life Home Care is a growing network of worker-owned home care cooperatives across California operating under a shared brand and centralized back-office support structure (Vivid Life Cooperative Headquarters). Our mission is to provide world-class home care that blends the best traditions of caregiving with modern, proven practices to create vibrant futures for all.

We partner with independent organizations, including nonprofits and community-based institutions, to build a cooperative ecosystem that improves access to quality care while uplifting caregivers as worker-owners.

**About Our Cooperative Model**
-------------------------------

### **What is a Worker-Owned Cooperative?**

A worker-owned cooperative is an organization owned and governed by its worker-members. In this model, caregivers and staff are not just employees—they are member-owners who participate in decision-making and share in the economic and organizational success of the cooperative.

Key principles include:

* **Democratic governance:** Members participate in decisions that affect their cooperative
* **Shared ownership:** Members contribute to and benefit from organizational performance
* **Local autonomy:** Each cooperative maintains decision-making authority within shared system standards
* **Shared services model:** Headquarters provides centralized systems, infrastructure, compliance, and operational support

Vivid Life operates as a network of independent cooperatives connected through shared systems, standards, and brand infrastructure.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing centralized systems, infrastructure, and daily operational performance across Vivid Life Home Care. This role ensures that Client Success Representatives (CSRs), Cooperative Admins, and caregiver member-owners across the cooperative network are fully supported to deliver high-quality, dignified care through efficient and scalable systems.

This leader serves as the operational backbone of the organization, connecting caregiver experience, client service delivery, and administrative infrastructure into a seamless, high-performing system.

This role combines systems management, training, technical support, implementation leadership, and data analysis across core platforms to drive operational consistency and efficiency.

This is not a traditional operations role. The person in this role will be supporting existing and new co-ops, including supporting caregivers and clients on a day-to-day basis. This will require the Operations Manager to be available and on-call outside of traditional working hours.The Operations Manager serves as the steward of shared infrastructure—creating and establishing standardized systems while preserving cooperative autonomy and local governance authority. This position works under the direction of the Director of Operations and Business Development and requires flexibility to support occasional after-hours and weekend operational needs.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
--------------------------------

The Operations Manager provides operational oversight and functional leadership across headquarters support functions and implementation teams.

**Direct Supervision May Include:**

**Authority Includes:**

**Does Not Include:**

One Firefly is an award-winning, remote-first marketing agency serving the residential and commercial custom integration industry. jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Behind every conserved artifact is a team making sure the right work happens at the right time. ProfessionLX is seeking a part-time Artifact Conservation Project Coordinator to support a National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) initiative preserving collections held by the Presidential Libraries and Museums. These collections—from gifts of state to personal belongings—offer a tangible connection to the people and events that have shaped American history.

You will bring organisation, clarity, and momentum to conservation projects across multiple institutions, working closely with NARA’s project team and library contacts. This role offers an experienced museum, library, or archives professional the opportunity to contribute to a national preservation initiative through a flexible, part-time commitment. Work is remote, averaging approximately 40 hours per month, with occasional in-person meetings as required.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

You will help the project team see the whole picture while keeping individual projects moving. By developing practical tracking tools and reporting templates, maintaining schedules, and staying in regular contact with project leads, you will make progress, upcoming milestones, and outstanding actions easy to follow.

Your ability to turn detailed information into clear, useful documents will be central to the role. Working with the project team, you will help draft statements of work for conservation vendors, prepare narrative and budget reports, and create presentations that explain what has been achieved and what comes next. You will also organise incoming vendor proposals and check them for completeness to support the team’s review.

Alongside the day-to-day coordination, you will help bring colleagues together to share the initiative’s work. This will include arranging project meetings and supporting conservation forums through scheduling, logistics, agenda planning, and presentation preparation. You may also contribute to outreach communications that help others understand the conservation work and its significance.

  
  

### **Requirements**

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING**

* At least 10 years of professional experience in the cultural heritage sector, working within a museum, library, archives, or comparable heritage organisation.
* Relevant experience coordinating artifact conservation projects within the past five years.
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and keep multiple projects, deadlines, and follow-up actions in view.
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn contributions from several stakeholders into coherent reports and presentations.
* A collaborative approach to working with specialists and institutional contacts, combined with the initiative to work independently in a remote role.
* Proficiency across Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

**YOUR EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS**

• A college degree in a humanities subject, or equivalent experience relevant to the work described.  

  

  
  

### **Benefits**

We offer great opportunities for personal and professional development in an international company, with a focus on supporting our customers to excel in their strategic goals. The role comes with a competitive salary package, paid time off, Federal holidays, and professional development. You will be a part of a dedicated group of colleagues who value teamwork and collaboration whose focus is to empower our customers.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

Veeva-Ostro builds the AI-powered engagement platform behind some of pharma's most innovative brand experiences — conversational virtual navigators, personalized content journeys, and omnichannel tools that give patients and HCPs real-time, accurate answers. As a Senior Program Manager on our Implementation/Professional Services team, you'll own the end-to-end quality of every deliverable, from client-facing designs and content matrices through PRC submission to pre-launch QA of the live tool, while developing the processes and leading the team of contractor editors who bring each build to life. * Review and QA project deliverables, including tool designs and the content library/matrix, for accuracy, consistency, and compliance before they move into client review

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, English, journalism, communications, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in medical/scientific editing, ideally within a life sciences marketing agency, medical communications agency, or pharmaceutical company, with direct experience editing pharma brand marketing or patient/HCP-facing digital content
* Proven experience guiding content through Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) or PRC review and incorporating client and reviewer feedback across multiple submission rounds
* Excellent attention to detail, with strong factchecking, proofreading, and reference/citation verification skills
* Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain editorial processes and QA procedures
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
**OUR MISSION**

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person’s cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help care teams focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you’re inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what’s possible, we’d love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

As Thyme Care’s newest **Sr. Associate, Workforce Management**, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving day-to-day operational excellence. You'll be responsible for developing forecasts, maintaining coverage models, and building scalable reporting tools that ensure our teams are equipped to meet demand and uphold service levels.

Our care model includes proactive communications and back-office tasking, which means precision and timing are everything. The staff groups you'll support are often lean and specialized, so your ability to manage capacity with accuracy and agility will have a direct impact on patient outcomes.

This role sits within the Care Delivery team and serves as a critical connector between frontline teams and leadership. You’ll lead stakeholder sessions, translate data into workforce plans, and build models that answer complex “what if” questions—like how we staff for expanded hours or prepare for new contract growth.

* Collaborate with care delivery leaders to ensure schedules reflect training, holidays, and business priorities

* Familiarity with CCaaS platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9, NICE CXone, Zoom Contact Center, 8x8, or Talkdesk
* Experience supporting proactive and back-office service models
* Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel, including pivot tables and time-based modeling
* A strong attention to detail when working with small and specialized staff groups where margin for error is limited
* Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across care delivery, operations, and leadership

* Experience building dashboards in Looker, Metabase, or Google Analytics
* Helpful if you know any SQL or scripting (Python, R) for advanced analysis
* Exposure to high-growth, startup, or remote-first environments
* Knowledge of service-level metrics and contact center operations

**WHAT LEADS TO SUCCESS**

Success in this role means being a reliable, agile partner to the teams that rely on accurate staffing, thoughtful scheduling, and responsive analysis. You’ll stand out if you bring a strong operational mindset, communicate clearly across functions, and thrive in environments where priorities can shift quickly and the work requires both precision and flexibility.

These are the traits and behaviors that will set you up for success:

**Act with our members in mind:** Thyme Care’s mission matters deeply to you—especially when it comes to delivering a seamless, supportive experience for our members through well-staffed, well-run teams.

**WFM Versatility:** You’re comfortable working across the full spectrum of workforce functions—forecasting, scheduling, reporting, and real-time monitoring—and can pivot between them as business needs evolve.

**Proactive problem-solving:** You don’t wait for perfect information. You move work forward, follow up, and take initiative to unblock others.

**Detail-Oriented Thinking:** You catch what others miss, especially when small errors can create big ripple effects for teammates and patients.

**Team Orientation:** You value collaboration and show up as a steady, trusted partner across care delivery, operations, and analytics.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
The International Research Olympiad (IRO) is a premier global STEM competition that tests science research ability for students aged 13–18. Students from more than 89 countries have taken part, making IRO the largest global community of young students interested in research.

Unlike traditional science olympiads that focus on specific subjects, IRO builds skills useful in any research discipline. Participants deepen their understanding of the scientific process and develop creativity, critical thinking and analysis skills, forming a foundation for later success. IRO is supported by a Board of Advisors and a growing network of partner organizations, including Indigo Research, Punjab Group and Google for Nonprofits, and runs student programs such as IRO Clubs and the IRO Ambassador program.  
  
The IRO Program Manager will be the dedicated full-time owner of IRO’s growth and day-to-day running. You will be accountable for growing registrations and paid participation, building the partnerships, clubs and community that bring students in, and running the competition smoothly as it scales.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. IRO already has a large global audience and an engaged student community; your job is to turn them, together with school and organizational partnerships, into a repeatable growth engine. You will work closely with IRO’s leadership, Board of Advisors, partner organizations, ambassadors and schools, and you are accountable not simply for running the competition, but for growing it.

### **Growth & Partnerships**

* Identify current and future mentor shortages in specific disciplines.
* Lead end-to-end recruitment efforts, including drafting job descriptions, posting roles, proactive sourcing, conducting interviews and sending offers and contracts.
* Provide training and onboarding for mentors to ensure a seamless transition into the program.
* Organize regular quality review meetings with mentors to discuss performance, share best practices, and drive continuous improvement.

### **Competition Operations & In-Person Finals**

* Coordinate the full competition cycle, including registration, online rounds, the in-person Finals, results, awards and certificates
* Keep practice exams, curriculum resources and rules up to date for students and teachers
* Provide clear, timely support to students, parents, teachers and partners throughout the cycle
* Own end-to-end logistics for the in-person IRO Finals, from venue selection and contracting through to event day
* Manage the Finals budget, vendors, catering, AV, signage, printed materials and awards
* Coordinate finalist communications, including invitations, registration, travel and accommodation guidance, visa letters and on-site schedules
* Plan the Finals program, including the exam, presentations, judging, ceremonies and networking, with advisors, judges, partners and volunteers
* Ensure student safety and wellbeing on site, including chaperone requirements, consent forms and emergency procedures
* Build processes and run post-event reviews so IRO and its Finals run smoothly at much higher volume without compromising quality

### **Board of Advisors & Reporting**

* Serve as the main point of contact for IRO’s Board of Advisors, managing communication, onboarding and day-to-day relationships
* Plan and run Board meetings, including scheduling, agendas, briefing materials, minutes and follow-up on action items
* Coordinate Board involvement in the competition, including exam and question review, judging, awards and the Finals
* Recruit and onboard new advisors as IRO grows, keeping Board profiles and public listings up to date
* Keep the Board informed with regular updates on registrations, results, partnerships and key decisions
* Create dashboards and regular reporting on registrations, revenue and partner performance for IRO leadership and the Board
* Track participant data accurately so outcomes, alumni and partner impact can be measured over time

### **Required Skills:**

* 1–3 years of experience in partnerships, program operations, events or growth
* Experience doing outreach to schools, educators or organizations and following through to signed partnerships
* Experience planning and running in-person events, ideally for students or international attendees
* Experience supporting a board, advisory group or senior stakeholders, including meetings and communications
* Experience coordinating multi-stakeholder projects with fixed deadlines
* Background in education, research, STEM, competitions or youth programming is a plus
* Experience in research competitions or olympiads, as a participant or organizer, is a plus

The **Veterinary CT Clinical Applications and Training Specialist** is responsible for developing and delivering operational training and applications support for Xoran’s veterinary CT product line. Escalate diagnostic questions to the interpreting veterinarian and equipment issues to Service.

Coordinate scanning workflows with the veterinary team responsible for patient preparation, anesthesia, monitoring, and recovery while reinforcing radiation safety and approved operating procedures.

· Demonstrated experience performing veterinary CT studies, including patient positioning, scan acquisition, reconstruction, technical image-quality assessment, and coordination with the veterinary patient-care team.

**Job Title: Learning and Development Strategist (L&D)**

**Department:** Learning & Development (L&D)  
**Reports To:** Director of Learning & Development  
**Position Type:** Full-Time  
**Salary Range:** $75,000 – $90,000 / year

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a performance-minded, strategic **Learning and Development Strategist** to align our organizational growth objectives with targeted capability-building strategies. Moving away from a simple "order-taking" approach to corporate training, you will act as an internal management consultant. You will embed directly with business unit leaders to diagnose performance bottlenecks, forecast critical skills gaps, and co-create impactful human-centered learner journeys. The ideal candidate pairs AI fluency and skills and data literacy with adult learning expertise to shift our L&D team from a cost center to a core performance enabler.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Business Consulting & Intake**

* Act as the dedicated L&D interface and trusted advisor for assigned functional business units.
* Conduct root-cause performance consultations with department leaders to determine whether productivity blocks stem from skills deficiencies or from separate process, technical, or talent challenges.
* Build strong, collaborative ties with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) to weave learning infrastructure tightly into broader talent pipelines, internal mobility routes, and success planning initiatives.

**Capabilities Assessment & Strategy Design**

* Apply qualitative and quantitative data methodologies to map active skill inventories, identify current workforce blind spots, and forecast future capability shifts.
* Use AI-assisted tools to synthesize findings and identify patterns, themes, and opportunities.

* Support and guide development of learning and program materials that integrates AI-assisted creation and review

* Map blended, adaptive learner journeys combining structured training modules with informal social loops and job-embedded experiential training.
* Partner with instructional design colleagues to deliver contextually precise, localized learning interventions.

**Program Governance, Metrics & ROI**

* Define success metrics that connect learning initiatives to performance outcomes
* Use data and analytics to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement
* Continuously refine learning programs based on feedback, performance data, and business needs
* Support the development of dashboards and reporting tools that provide visibility into learning impact

**Qualifications & Competencies**

* 5–8+ years of experience in Learning & Development, instructional design, or performance consulting
* Strong foundation in adult learning principles, instructional design, and curriculum development
* Experience conducting learning needs analysis and translating findings into structured solutions
* Demonstrated use of AI tools (LLMs, content generation, workflow automation) in a professional setting
* Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actionable learning strategies
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in construction, engineering, manufacturing, or technically complex industries
* Familiarity with LMS/LXP platforms and learning technologies
* Experience developing scalable training programs across multiple locations or functions
* Exposure to AI-assisted learning tools and digital content development platforms

RFG Advisory is scaling its growth engine, and Revenue Operations sits at the center of it. We are hiring a Revenue Operations Manager with a Marketing Operations lean to mature our outbound motion, sharpen how we score and attribute leads, and build a seamless journey from first marketing touch through frontline sales.

You will partner daily with our Marketing and Business Development teams, own much of our HubSpot configuration, and turn our data into reporting and analysis that leadership acts on. This is a high-impact role with visibility to the C-suite. You will have a corporate Claude account connected to our core systems, and we expect you to put it to work.

**﻿Location:** This role can be in our Birmingham office or remote.

* If in **Birmingham, AL**, our office works a hybrid schedule (3 days in-office, 2 remote).
* If remote, occasional travel to Birmingham will be required including onboarding.

**Reports to:** Senior Director of Revenue Operations

**﻿**

**﻿What You'll Do**

*HubSpot Administration & Systems*

* Own day-to-day administration and configuration of HubSpot Marketing Hub and Sales Hub, including properties, workflows, lifecycle stages, lists, sequences, and user permissions.
* Maintain data quality and governance standards so records stay accurate, deduplicated, and reportable.
* Manage HubSpot's connections to CRM-adjacent tools, and evaluate new tools against real business need.
* Document processes, field definitions, and system changes so the stack stays easy to understand as it grows.

*Outbound & Pipeline Operations*

* Partner with Business Development and Marketing leadership to scale and mature our outbound motion, from list building and sequences to routing and activity tracking.
* Build lead handoff and routing rules that get prospects from Marketing to frontline sales quickly and with full context.
* Define and monitor service levels and conversion rates between funnel stages.

*Lead Scoring & Attribution*

* Refine and maintain lead scoring models using fit and engagement signals, and recalibrate them against closed-won outcomes.
* Build and evolve attribution models that show which campaigns and channels create pipeline and revenue.
* Partner with Marketing on campaign setup, UTM standards, and tracking so attribution data can be trusted.

*Reporting, Analytics & Insights*

* Build and maintain reports and dashboards for Marketing, Business Development, and executive leadership.
* Analyze funnel, campaign, and rep performance data, then interpret what it means and recommend action from a RevOps perspective.
* Present findings clearly to stakeholders up to the C-suite.

*AI & Automation*

* Use your corporate Claude account and its connectors to speed up reporting, analysis, data hygiene, and documentation.
* Spot repetitive work across Marketing and Sales and replace it with automation or AI-assisted workflows.
* Share what works so the broader team adopts it.

  
Requirements:  
  

**Experience**

* 2-5 years of experience in Marketing Operations or Revenue Operations.
* Hands-on HubSpot administration and configuration experience, ideally across both Marketing Hub and Sales Hub.

* Experience building lead scoring or attribution models preferred.

* Clear written and verbal communicator who can translate between Marketing, Sales, and leadership.
* Self-directed and organized; comfortable owning multiple priorities on a lean team.
* Embraces AI and actively looks for ways to leverage it in their work.

**Technology & Tools**
